title: Handbook
lead: A short overview — no pressure, just for looking things up.

intro.label: Introduction
intro.text: First launch or open again manually

plan.label: Plan
plan.text: Day not started yet / after reset

plan.title: 2. Plan
morningItems: Short morning (default): mood → still open → start; rest under “Plan a little more” — calmer, less freeze
Full plan: work, life, and sizes right away — more overview
Switch: Settings → “Short morning” on or off
plan.buddyP: Short text at the top: greeting, mood tip, note about open tasks from the last run.
moodItems: Pretty good — normal amount and times
So-so — fewer points, slightly longer boxes
Hard today — clearly less, more time
plan.moodNote: For today only. No judgement across days.
workItems: When capacity is full: Buddy warns, add is blocked
lifeItems: ✕ on the row: remove from today’s plan only
× on the chip: hide suggestion permanently
Your own anchors stay saved as suggestions
plan.carryP: Open tasks from the last day or “Plan a new day”. Take over (watch capacity) or discard.
plan.startP: Can start with tasks — or with an empty day and add later. Then Focus screen.

fokus.title: 3. Focus
activeItems: Timer, Pause / Resume, Done, Later / skip
fokus.checkinP: At set intervals: still on it, drifted, or pause.
fokus.feierabendP: When work is done: sparks unlock. Life tasks may still follow.
fokus.freezeP: Leave the app → timer pauses. Optional gentle notifications. Adjustable below.

done.title: 4. Wrap-up
items: Buddy summary — no guilt at 0 done
“Plan a new day” keeps open items for “Still open”

capacity.label: Capacity
capacity.text: How many work tasks of which size

shortMorning.label: Short morning
shortMorning.text: On = thin start; off = full plan

drawer.label: The drawer
drawer.text: Optional. Own app at /schublade; off by default in Tagesanker. Shared data/sync.

park.label: Park
park.text: Note, sketch, or short voice note

vault.label: Vault
vault.text: Open only after work is done or skipped

ttl.label: Shelf life
ttl.text: max. 7 days — email first if set, then delete

delete.label: Delete
delete.text: Per entry in the open vault

regulate.title: 7. Regulate
regulate.lead: Top right “Calm” — tap when it’s too much. Quiet full-screen mode; timer pauses.

data.title: 8. Data
items: Default: everything local in this browser
Optional device sync: same state on several devices (email code)
Without sync: another browser or clearing cache = data gone
No forced account — sync only if you turn it on
